row.title: SOCIAL-RELAY-1: post to owner's accounts via token-gated relay
row.body: Buffer (LinkedIn, X, Substack) and Mastodon posting reuse the saved logins through a relay route added to the qnfo-social Worker (owner approved 2026-11-21); the publisher reads SOCIAL_RELAY_URL and SOCIAL_RELAY_TOKEN from the tick Worker. No QNFO paper posts: the Worker has no schedule.
